dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Chabondo village, Kalehe Territory, Sud-Kivu Province, DR. of the Congo as of 09 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230508COD, GDACS Id: 1101981** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by landslides in Chabondo village, Kalehe Territory, Sud-Kivu Province, DR. of the Congo as detected from a Pleiades image acquired on the 09th May 2023. Within the extent of this map, at least 544 structures appear to be affected or potentially affected by landslides. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
